inlines.v: LITHONTRIP'TIC, adjective [Gr. stone, and to wear or break.] Having the quality of dissolving the stone in the bladder or kidneys. LITHONTRIP'TIC, noun A medicine which has the power of dissolving the stone in the bladder or kidneys; a solvent of stone in the human urinary passage.
